title: KKE Physics Demo
description: A dedicated demo for AMD FEMFX deformable-material physics: several tetrahedral objects fall from varied heights onto a real-world-scale floor, with a camera actually suited to that scale rather than the tiny render-scale hack kke_demo_game needs. Click 'Spawn tetrahedron' in the Physics panel to add more live.

requirements.notes: Best-effort, developer-declared estimates -- see README 'Estimated hardware requirements'. FEMFX's own simulation is CPU-side (single-threaded task system stand-in -- see README 'Physics: AMD FEMFX integration'); GPU load here is light, just the render bridge.
